Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and left join compound_structures on molregno to include SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4028801. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID.
